guidance: A printed fraction such as ½: if neither reading has it, pick Neither, then type the word in the box. The ⌨ button beside Send shows buttons for ½ ¼ ¾ and other characters a keyboard lacks, and 1/2 typed out counts the same.
intro: These words come from English-language newspaper pages in Chronicling America, the Library of Congress's collection of historic American newspapers. Two machine readings (OCR) disagree on each word.
